Elena — following up with the detailed breakdown you requested. Two files attached: a full pricing matrix and a small worked-example export. Highlights:

1) Token naming and columns: we will include token_type (chat_prompt/chat_completion/embeddings/system), tokens_in, tokens_out, total_tokens, request_id, timestamp, model_name.

2) Rounding: Redwood bills at the request granularity; we round token usage to the nearest whole token per request and show both raw (pre-round) and rounded columns in the export. The invoice sums reflect the rounded-per-request totals.

3) Discount application: per your contract (deal FIN-2027-0423) the default is a blended effective discount applied to eligible token spend for the invoice period. For transparency we will show both the blended calculation and a marginal, banded calculation (bands: 0-250M, 250M-750M, 750M+ tokens). Attached pricing matrix demonstrates both approaches side-by-side.

4) True-up: month-end true-up is performed against committed units on the anniversary date; any overage is billed at the overage band rate, with the effective discount baked in per the chosen method. We'll itemize the true-up rows in the export.

Next steps:
- I'm attaching token_pricing_matrix.csv (worked example included).
- Soojin (cc) will deliver the full per-request export and the annotated invoice-line mapping by EOD Monday (2027-08-09).
- If you want a short call to walk through the sample and confirm the reconciliation assumptions, propose Mon 11:00am PT?
